description.p: protium shows what Steam actually configured for Proton on this machine: the compatibility tool assigned to each game, the launch options, the ProtonDB tier and the local disk usage. Every statement names its source, its meaning and its limits. Values protium cannot verify stay unknown instead of being guessed.

ul.li: Library overview across all Steam libraries with covers, size and the assigned tool
Install and remove GE-Proton releases from GitHub, with verified download
Set compatibility tool and launch options per game through a guarded write path
Find and clean up orphaned Wine prefixes, shader caches and the trash
Copy a privacy-preserving support record for bug reports

description.p: protium zeigt, was Steam auf diesem Rechner wirklich für Proton eingestellt hat: das zugeordnete Kompatibilitätswerkzeug je Spiel, die Startoptionen, die ProtonDB-Bewertung und den lokalen Speicherbedarf. Jede Aussage nennt Quelle, Bedeutung und Grenze; Werte, die protium nicht belegen kann, bleiben unbekannt.
Structural round after an external audit: one write path, one VDF tokenizer, stable error classes instead of raw texts, plus a linear tokenizer and honest UI states.
Translated error messages, a new history view with the local log, a single-instance guard and a descriptor-bound write path.
Wayland hook finds the system library on distributions without development packages.
Signed checksums, build provenance attestation and a pinned build environment.
